analyst.summary: Sapphire Foods is a large Yum! Brands franchisee (KFC/Pizza Hut/Taco Bell) across India, Sri Lanka and the Maldives, currently in the process of an all-stock merger with fellow franchisee Devyani International to create India's largest F&B franchise platform. Like Devyani, Sapphire posted a net loss for FY26 even as the most recent quarter returned to small profitability, and promoter/sponsor ownership has fallen sharply since its 2021 IPO. We rate it a Hold: real scale and a credible consolidation plan, but profitability and merger execution both still need to be proven out over the next 12-18 months.
